Game Overview

Stamp Roll is a casual title where guide a cube-shaped stamp through brain-teasing puzzles, racing against the clock to align and imprint over marked squares. Master your moves to avoid pitfalls, dodge obstacles, and gather ink. Will you achieve stamping perfection or fall into endless desk-top chaos?

How to Play

Stamp Roll keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Guide a cube-shaped stamp through brain-teasing puzzles, racing against the clock to align and imprint over marked squares. Master your moves to avoid pitfalls, dodge obstacles, and gather ink. Will you achieve stamping perfection or fall into endless desk-top chaos?
